# Foundation CSV fixture

These CSVs are a row subset with LF line endings and unchanged field values of the official [USDA April 30, 2026 Foundation CSV ZIP](https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/fdc-datasets/FoodData_Central_foundation_food_csv_2026-04-30.zip), downloaded for TKT-43af6469. Nutrient, category, and measurement definitions retain the official table layout. Food and related tables include broccoli 321900 and 747447, egg 748967, pasta 2758999, and research sample 319874. ZIPs are assembled in temporary test memory; the full source archive is not committed.

Independent expectations: broccoli 747447 has specific Atwater energy 32 kcal/100 g, general Atwater 39, legacy 31, protein 2.57 g, fat 0.34 g, carbohydrate 6.27 g, sodium 36 mg, and portion 187633 is one chopped cup weighing 76 g. Two cups weigh 152 g and contain 48.64 kcal. Egg 748967 has specific energy 147 kcal/100 g, general 143, legacy 148, fiber 0 g, and portion 193781 weighing 50.3 g. Pasta has no tracked nutrient rows; it remains unselectable. Some tests deliberately replace CSV contents to exercise malformed values and schemas.

`name-only.sqlite` is a frozen compatibility fixture generated by
`buildUsdaGeneration` from commit `ca9e19d`, before the alias index existed.
Its 19 synthetic descriptions cover singular/plural headings, USDA's fish and
summer-squash headings, unrelated winter squash, eggplant, and Grade A versus
Grade AAA. IDs 1–19 follow that corpus's insertion order. Nutrition is copied
from a fixture record and is irrelevant to this search-only test. The restore
worker copies these original bytes into a temporary installation; assertions
exercise public catalog searches and verify that queries do not rewrite it.
